title: What happened in AI — Oct 20, 2026
intro: DeepSeek open-sourced the inference software behind its models on the same day the U.S. banned its products from federal systems.
Agent memory and self-verification tooling shipped from Databricks and several open-source projects.
highlights: DeepSeek open-sources its large-scale inference stack to cut serving cost.
U.S. bans DeepSeek from federal civilian IT systems; China objects.
Databricks launches managed agent memory on Agent Bricks.
llm-d 1.0 and vLLM TorchTPU advance open inference serving.
Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 arrive in Google Antigravity.
